Contract Generator.contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::enterLoanInformation(requestid: Integer,name: String,loanamount: Real,loanpurpose: String,income: Real,phonenumber: Integer,postaladdress: String,zipcode: Integer,email: String,workreferences: String,creditreferences: String,checkingaccountnumber: Integer,securitynumber: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		foundLoanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		if foundLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newLoanRequest: LoanRequest in
		newLoanRequest.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(newLoanRequest) and
		newLoanRequest.RequestID = requestid and
		newLoanRequest.Name = name and
		newLoanRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and
		newLoanRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and
		newLoanRequest.Income = income and
		newLoanRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and
		newLoanRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and
		newLoanRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and
		newLoanRequest.Email = email and
		newLoanRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		newLoanRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		newLoanRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		newLoanRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = newLoanRequest and
		result = true 
		else self.CurrentLoanRequest = foundLoanRequest and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
